title: Sony Guarantees PlayStation 5 Stock and Price Until 2027
description: Reports indicate Sony has secured memory supplies for the PlayStation 5, ensuring availability and price stability through 2027, particularly regarding the launch of GTA 6.

sources.title: Sony confirma boa notícia para quem pretende comprar um PS5 esse ano
Sony garante estoque de memória para o PS5 e afasta risco de falta de consoles com GTA 6
Vai jogar GTA 6? Sony garante preço e estoque do PS5 até 2027

sections.heading: Stock and Memory Supply
paragraphs: According to Adrenaline, Sony has guaranteed the stock of memory for the PS5. This measure is intended to avert the risk of a shortage of consoles with the release of GTA 6. Additionally, Canaltech reports that Sony has guaranteed the stock of the PS5 until 2027.

sections.heading: Price Stability
paragraphs: Canaltech states that Sony has guaranteed the price of the PS5 until 2027. This assurance comes alongside reports of good news for those intending to buy a PS5 this year, according to Terra.

sections.heading: Impact of GTA 6
paragraphs: The anticipated release of GTA 6 is a significant factor in these preparations. Adrenaline notes that securing memory stock is specifically aimed at preventing console shortages when the game launches. Canaltech also links the guarantees of both price and stock to the period leading up to and including the game's release.

faq.q: Has Sony secured PS5 stock for the future?
faq.a: According to Adrenaline and Canaltech, Sony has guaranteed memory stock and console availability until 2027.

faq.q: Will the price of the PS5 remain stable?
faq.a: Canaltech reports that Sony has guaranteed the price of the PS5 until 2027.

faq.q: Why is Sony securing memory stock?
faq.a: According to Adrenaline, Sony is securing memory stock to prevent a shortage of consoles associated with the launch of GTA 6.
